title: Two Boys in Garden under Trellis Arch, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around the mid-1930s capturing two young boys standing together in a backyard setting. A large decorative wooden garden arch with trellis lattice framing frames the garden path. On the left is a wooden siding house, and a wooden picket fence stretches across the background. One boy wears round eyeglasses, a knit sweater, and shorts, while the other stands beside him near a wooden wagon or stool.
